title: Flavor Pairing Finder
text: Search over 40 ingredient flavor profiles to find best, unexpected, and cuisine-affinity pairings. Pairings are scored by shared aromatic compounds, with seasonality and cooking-method guidance for proteins, vegetables, fruits, dairy, grains, herbs, spices, and more.

title: How flavor pairing works
text: PairDish scores ingredient pairs by shared aromatic and flavor compounds. Each of 40+ ingredients carries flavor notes, an aromatic profile, intensity, best and unexpected pairings, cuisine affinities, and seasonality; higher shared-aroma overlap yields a higher compatibility score.

title: Recipe Nutrition Calculator
text: Calculate calories, protein, carbs, fat, and per-serving nutrition for any recipe. Paste ingredients and servings to get a full nutrition breakdown for meal planning and diet tracking.

title: Macro Calculator
text: Set protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets based on your goal and body metrics. Get a personalized macro split and calorie recommendation for weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain.

title: Meal Prep Calculator
text: Plan batch cooking and meal prep: scale servings, budget portions across the week, and align with your macro or nutrition goals. Includes a macro-focused meal planning guide.

title: Recipe Scaler
text: Scale any recipe's ingredient quantities up or down to match your serving count. Adjust portion sizes while keeping ingredient ratios intact.

title: Ingredient Substitution Finder
text: Find practical ingredient swaps that preserve flavor and structure. Covers substitutions for common pantry items such as flour, sugar, butter, eggs, and more, with flavor-aware suggestions.

title: Glycemic Index
text: Reference glycemic index and glycemic load values for common foods to support blood-sugar-conscious food choices and meal planning.

title: Nutrition Articles & Meal Planning Guides
text: Guides on recipe nutrition, meal planning with macros, high-protein meal prep, grocery-budget meal planning, and pantry planning — practical advice for turning ingredients into better meals.

title: Party & Buffet Calculators
text: Plan how much food to prepare for parties and buffets, including appetizer and per-person quantities so you neither under- nor over-cater for your guests.
